fusions.name: Lily Landing
fusions.desc: Lands heavily, dealing 12 water damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stunning them for 1 second. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 25%).

fusions.name: Tongue Lash
fusions.desc: Lashes a target up to 5 tiles away with a sticky tongue, dealing 4 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and slowing it by 25% for 2 seconds. You move 20% faster for 2 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Glance Away
fusions.desc: Springs you 3 tiles from where you stood. For 3 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you.

fusions.name: Stillwater Ambush
fusions.desc: After 6 seconds without a critical hit, your next strike has 40% more critical hit chance. You have 5% more dodge chance. Once every 8 seconds.
